text: 但有个坑：网关健康检查探的是写死的默认端口。
speech_note: asr-1.0 transcribed 写死 as 协死 (coverage 0.95), so the take is NOT verified. The flag is off only so the 2026-10-29 integration test could render; turn it back on once a human has listened to assets/voice/presenter-opening.wav.
note: The 1024 cut opens on a face carrying the first hook line. Declared here so a later build cannot drop the opening silently: the composer refuses this variant when the contract is unmet.
